note: One MS row. Held first as a judgement (a dispersed-site system with no single place to pin), then added at AWH's call the same day as one entry pinned at Blue Lake Recreation Area, with the spread described in the note.

added.name: Delta National Forest Campsites
added.caveat: 56 sites over ~12 forest roads, not one campground; pinned at Blue Lake Recreation Area (3 of the sites); water only at the ranger work center; a WMA

history.why: 56 reservable primitive sites spread along about 12 forest roads (FSR 703/707/715/720, Dummyline Road, the greentree reservoirs, Blue Lake and Little Sunflower River recreation areas) across a Wildlife Management Area, with potable water only at the ranger work center and no per-site coordinates. It is real, bookable, RV-length camping, but no single pin describes it; raised with AWH, and a Blue Lake Recreation Area entry would be the natural way in if he wants it
